events.title: 🚜NUCA LV Backhoe Rodeo
events.location: 628 W Craig Rd, North Las Vegas, Nevada, 89032
events.description:
The NUCA LV Backhoe Rodeo is a family-friendly industry event that brings together contractors, utility companies, equipment suppliers, public agencies, employees, and their families for a day of competition, networking, and community engagement. 

This year’s event will feature: 
•	Backhoe operator competitions with a $20,000 grand prize
•	Cash prizes for second and third place
•	A company team competition
•	Hourly giveaways
•	Kids’ activities
•	Food, entertainment, and opportunities to connect with the Las Vegas construction and utility community

Event Schedule 
Gates Open: 7:00 a.m.
Competition Begins: 8:00 a.m.
Competition Ends: 12:00 p.m.
Awards: 12:00–1:00 p.m. 

Location 
CRAIG RANCH Regional Park
628 W Craig Road, North Las Vegas, NV 89032

events.title: 🦺Competent Person Training for Excavations - OSHA Subpart P
events.location: 4011 W Cheyenne Ave, North Las Vegas, Nevada, 89032
events.description:
We are excited to offer an upcoming Competent Person Training for Excavations – OSHA Subpart P. This training utilizes NUCA training materials and curriculum and is being offered complimentary to our local NUCA members and their employees.
Upon successful completion of the training, each student will receive a NUCA Certificate and wallet-size certification card.

Training Details
•	Date: Saturday, November 7, 2026
•	Time: 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM (check in 6:45am)
•	Duration: 8 hours
•	Lunch: Provided
•	Cost: No charge for NUCA members and their employees
•	Location: 4011 W. Cheyenne Ave., North Las Vegas, NV 89032
•	Language: English or Spanish, based on the needs of our NUCA members
 We are currently building the class roster and ask that you send us a list of the employees you would like to attend.
TO REGISTER send your company name, student name, preference for English or Spanish, phone #, email, and supervisor contact info to jdominguez@wscilv.com and jennifer@nucalasvegas.com.
